purpose: Approved Bella Frame Rate shared numeric design and MDB-first priority with only independently read header fallback.
status: Approved requirements; no runtime implementation or OldScanner cutover.

authorization.planApproval: Great - note this down as the plan.
authorization.headerReadInstruction: read from MDB only - do not fall back to opening media header (unless we're reading the media header anyway.
authorization.clarifyingQuestion: When a media header is already being read for another reason and supplies a usable Frame Rate, should Bella keep a usable MDB rate or prefer the header rate?
authorization.selectedAnswer: Keep MDB first; use the header only if MDB is unusable (recommended)
authorization.scope: Frame Rate. Duration retains its earlier strictly MDB-only rule. Other fields header policies are not changed by this approval.

agreedBellaRule.mdbOwner: Exact physical video file own MDB descriptor OMFI:MDFL:SampleRate, with complete identity/reference and typed-value qualification.
agreedBellaRule.storage: Preserve original numerator/denominator and necessary source/type meaning in a small numeric value. Reuse this MDB SampleRate with own Length for Duration; no separate permanent duplicate rate or rounded label solely for Frame Rate.
agreedBellaRule.interpretation: Apply the already approved scoped exact Avid video-rate interpretation for qualified MDB ExactEditRate values, preserving original words. Generic/header Rational values retain their own supported semantics.
agreedBellaRule.presentation: Generate familiar labels at table/CSV presentation; sort using numeric interpreted rates rather than reparsing rounded text. Audio Frame Rate is blank.

priority.condition: Usable physical file own video descriptor SampleRate.

priority.source: Already independently read same-file media header
priority.condition: MDB rate is unusable AND the header read is independently required AND it supplies a usable own-file video rate.

agreedBellaRule.usableMdbWins: A usable MDB rate remains selected regardless of a header rate availability or disagreement. Do not read/collect an alternative solely for comparison.
agreedBellaRule.unavailable: Blank if no eligible usable rate; retain physical file. Frame Rate cannot itself trigger a header read.
agreedBellaRule.completionOrder: Selection follows fixed priority independent of task completion order; a later usable MDB result supersedes a provisional header fallback.
agreedBellaRule.durationBoundary: Header fallback affects Frame Rate only. It must not repair or override Duration, replace its MDB count/rate, or provide a missing Duration clock. Duration remains MDB-only even if header data exists.
agreedBellaRule.independentAvailability: Usable MDB SampleRate can supply Frame Rate even if own Length is unavailable and Duration is blank.
agreedBellaRule.audioBoundary: Class-specific audio Sample Rate source and interpretation remain unchanged; an internal audio Duration display clock does not populate visible Frame Rate.
agreedBellaRule.timecodeBoundary: Nominal numbering bases and drop-frame flags affect Duration numbering, not actual FPS or Frame Rate labels.
agreedBellaRule.sourceOpeningBoundary: A fallback source being second in priority never authorizes opening it. Only a separate already-authorized scan reason can cause header read.

priorityTable.fallback: Own usable header rate only from independent header read and only when MDB unusable

priorityTable.first: Own MDB Length/SampleRate with agreed interpretation

remaining: Final shared-interpreter naming; AvidVideoRateInterpreter is a possible working name.
Generic/uncommon-rate display precision and supported wire/header layout coverage.
Duration audio display-clock and qualified drop-frame owner/fallback decisions.
Other fields source/read policies remain governed by their own decisions and reviews.
supersedes: Earlier pending/proposed Frame Rate approval wording in the referenced historical Frame Rate evidence.
Earlier deferral of Frame Rate header-read trigger and source priority.
Any interpretation that sharing a rate permits an already-read header to repair MDB-only Duration.

validation.scope: Requirements documentation and JSON only. Source checks from previous review remain in referenced evidence.

supersededInPartBy.scope: Only the blanket MDB-only Duration source restriction is superseded by the approved database-unavailable MXF fallback. Original authorization, findings and other rules remain historical and unchanged.
